items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Milt was a good friend of mine.

ctx.x: Any specific memories of the date?
Not really. All I know is I liked Milt. Milt was a good friend of mine.
The date with Monk, then. I’ve read a quote from you that you hadn’t worked with Monk before that; that you had to go in and basically read the music down...
